summary: Revision 1 matches the approved integrated spec v0.1 and local-browser direction. It limits this increment to S-01/S-07 package, host, and UI compatibility evidence plus design preparation. The plan separates package availability, real integration, and untested capabilities; guards against loading private configuration or invoking paid models; and requires reproducible checks and an independent final review. Figma production and later product behavior remain appropriately held. No material scope or verification gap blocks this bounded spike.
